# Temperature Profiles

## Data

```{r}
profiles<-read_csv("data/temp_logs/apex_rainbow_profiles.csv")%>%
  mutate(profile=as.factor(profile))

filenames <- list.files(path = "data/temp_logs", pattern = "\\d+\\.csv$",full.names=TRUE)  

actual_temperature <- lapply(filenames,function(i) read.csv(i)%>% mutate(file=i))%>% bind_rows()%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  mutate(treatment=parse_number(file))%>%
  select(-file)%>%
  mutate(date=force_tz(mdy_hm(date),"US/Hawaii"))%>%
  filter(date>="2021-08-12 10:00",date<="2021-08-12 16:25")%>%
  mutate(treatment=as.factor(treatment))%>%
  mutate(start=force_tz(ymd_hm("2021-08-12 10:00"),"US/Hawaii"))%>%
  mutate(duration=as.numeric(difftime(date,start,units="mins")))

```

## Plots

```{r, fig.path="figs/", fig.width=7.2, fig.height=3.5}
x_limits <- c(0, 385)
y_limits <- c(27, 38.1)

plot_1a<-ggplot(profiles)+
  geom_line(aes(minute,setpoint,color=profile))+
  xlab("Time (Minutes)")+
  ylab("Temperature (°C)")+
  theme_classic(base_size=8)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,385,60), limits = x_limits)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(27,38,1), limits = y_limits)+
  scale_color_discrete(name="Treatment (°C)")+
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  guides(color=guide_legend(reverse=TRUE));plot_1a

plot_1b<-ggplot(actual_temperature)+
  geom_line(aes(duration,temp,color=treatment))+
  xlab("Time (Minutes)")+
  ylab("Temperature (°C)")+
  scale_color_discrete(name="Treatment (°C)")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)+
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_line(), plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), legend.position = "right")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,385,60),limits = x_limits)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(27,38,1),limits = y_limits);plot_1b

legend<- get_legend(plot_1a + theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), 
                                    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),  
                                    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
                                    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")))

compare<-plot_grid(plot_1a+theme(legend.position="none", plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0.5,"cm")), 
                   plot_1b+theme(legend.position = "none",axis.ticks.y=element_line(),
                                 plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0.5, "cm")),
                   nrow = 1, ncol=2, labels = c("A", "B"), hjust = c(-0.5,0.5), align='hv', scale=0.9)
plot_1c<-plot_grid(compare, legend, rel_widths = c(0.6, 0.1))
plot_1c

ggsave("output/plot_1c.pdf",
       plot=plot_1c,
       width=7.2,height=3.5,units="in")
```

## Temperature Treatment Variations

```{r}
temperature_treatment_summary <- actual_temperature%>%
  filter(date>="2021-08-12 12:40",date<="2021-08-12 13:30")%>%
  mutate(treatment=as.factor(treatment))%>%
  mutate(start=force_tz(ymd_hm("2021-08-12 10:00"),"US/Hawaii"))%>%
  mutate(duration=as.numeric(difftime(date,start,units="mins")))%>%
  mutate(treatment=as.numeric(as.character(treatment)))%>%
  filter(treatment!=27)%>%
  group_by(treatment)%>%
  summarize(average=mean(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            max=max(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            min=min(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            sd=sd(temp,na.rm=TRUE))%>%
  mutate(across(c(average,max,min,sd),\(x) round(x,2)))

control_temperature_summary <- actual_temperature%>%
  filter(date>="2021-08-12 10:00",date<="2021-08-12 16:25")%>%
  mutate(treatment=as.numeric(as.character(treatment)))%>%
  filter(treatment==27)%>%
  group_by(treatment)%>%
  summarize(average=mean(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            max=max(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            min=min(temp,na.rm=TRUE),
            sd=sd(temp,na.rm=TRUE))%>%
  mutate(across(c(average,max,min,sd),round,2))
```

## Temperature Treatment Variation Table

```{r}
control_temperature_summary<-control_temperature_summary%>%
  mutate(period="Full 6h exposure")

temperature_treatment_summary<-temperature_treatment_summary%>%
  mutate(period="Peak exposure")

full_temperature_table<-bind_rows(control_temperature_summary,temperature_treatment_summary)%>%
  mutate(`Mean ± SD (°C)`=paste0(average," ± ",sd))%>%
  select(treatment,`Mean ± SD (°C)`,max,min,period)%>%
  rename(`Treatment (°C)`=treatment,
         `Maximum (°C)`=max,
         `Minimum (°C)`=min,
         `Treatment Period`=period,)

full_temperature_table_word<-flextable(full_temperature_table)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman",part="all")%>%
  fontsize(size=12,part="all")%>%
  set_caption("Table S1. Measured temperature variations for the control (27°C) and temperature treatments (28-38°C).")%>%
  bold(part="header")%>%
  align(align="center",part="all")%>%
  autofit()
  

full_temperature_table_word

save_as_docx(full_temperature_table_word,
             path="output/full_temperature_summary_table.docx")
```

## Water Temperature For Recruit Grow Out

### Data

```{r}
himb_temp_grow_out_2021<-read.table("data/temp_data_grow_out/HIMB_temp_grow_out_2021.txt",header=TRUE,comment.char="",fill=TRUE)%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  rename(year=1,
         month=2,
         day=3,
         hour=4,
         minute=5)%>%
  filter(year!="#yr")%>%
  mutate(date=ymd_hm(paste(year,month,day,hour,minute)))%>%
  select(date,wtmp)

himb_temp_grow_out_2022<-read.table("data/temp_data_grow_out/HIMB_temp_grow_out_2022.txt",header=TRUE,comment.char="",fill=TRUE)%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  rename(year=1,
         month=2,
         day=3,
         hour=4,
         minute=5)%>%
  filter(year!="#yr")%>%
  mutate(date=ymd_hm(paste(year,month,day,hour,minute)))%>%
  select(date,wtmp)

himb_temp_grow_out_full<-bind_rows(himb_temp_grow_out_2021,himb_temp_grow_out_2022)%>%
  filter(date>="2021-08-01 00:00",
         date<="2022-02-01 00:00")%>%
  distinct(date,.keep_all=TRUE)%>%
  arrange(date)%>%
  rename(temperature=wtmp)%>%
  mutate(temperature=as.numeric(temperature))%>%
  mutate(temperature=na_if(temperature,999))

average_grow_out_temp<-himb_temp_grow_out_full%>%
  filter(date>="2021-08-12 00:00",
         date<="2022-01-26 23:59")%>%
  summarize(mean_temp=mean(temperature,na.rm=TRUE))

average_grow_out_temp

```

# Larval Survivorship

## Data

```{r}
larval_survivorship_24hrs<-readxl::read_xlsx("data/larvae_counts.xlsx", sheet = 2)%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  select(-c(x5,x6,x7))%>%
  pivot_longer(!treatment,names_to = "replicate",values_to = "count")%>%
  mutate(time=24)

larval_survivorship_0hrs<-readxl::read_xlsx("data/larvae_counts.xlsx", sheet = 1)%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  pivot_longer(!treatment,names_to = "replicate",values_to = "count")%>%
  mutate(time=0)

larval_survivorship<-bind_rows(larval_survivorship_0hrs, larval_survivorship_24hrs)%>%
  mutate(count=case_when(count>30~30,TRUE~count))%>%
  rename(alive=count)%>%
  mutate(dead=30-alive)

table(larval_survivorship$alive)
levels(as.factor(larval_survivorship$treatment))

```

## Statistical Analysis

```{r}
larval_survivorship_glmmtmb <- glmmTMB(cbind(alive,dead)~as.factor(treatment)*as.factor(time),family = "betabinomial", data = larval_survivorship)
summary(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)

larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_res <-simulateResiduals(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)
plot(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_res)

larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion <- testDispersion(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_res)
larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion

car::Anova(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)

##within each temperature treatment, did survivorship change between 0h and 24h?##
emm_larval_survivorship_glmmtmb<-emmeans(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb,~time|treatment,type="response")
summary(emm_larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)

larval_survivorship_time_contrast<-contrast(emm_larval_survivorship_glmmtmb,method="pairwise")
larval_survivorship_time_contrast
larval_survivorship_time_contrast_holm<-test(larval_survivorship_time_contrast,by=NULL,adjust="holm")
larval_survivorship_time_contrast_holm

##how was survivorship different compared to control between 0h and 24h
emm_larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl<- emmeans(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb, ~ treatment | time, type="response")
summary(emm_larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl)

larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl_contrast<- contrast(emm_larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl,method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1) ###make table 
larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl_contrast
```

## Plot

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3.5}

larval_survivorship_plot <- ggplot(larval_survivorship)+
  geom_jitter(aes(treatment, alive, color=as.factor(time)),height = 0, width = 0.4)+
  geom_smooth(aes(treatment, alive, color=as.factor(time),fill=as.factor(time)),alpha=0.2)+ 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(27,38,1))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,30,5))+
  xlab("Treatment (°C)")+
  ylab("Number of Intact Larvae")+
  scale_color_discrete("Time (Hours)")+
  scale_fill_discrete("Time (Hours)")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.14,0.20),legend.title = element_text (size=8))+
  annotate("text",27,15,label="Treatment p<0.001\nTime p<0.001\nTreatment*Time p<0.001",hjust=0, size=2.89)

larval_survivorship_plot

ggsave("output/larval_survivorship_plot.pdf",
       plot=larval_survivorship_plot,
       width=5.5,height=3.5,units="in")

```

## Tables

```{r}
larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table<-as.data.frame(summary(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)$coefficients$cond)%>%
  rownames_to_column("term")%>%
  rename(`Term`=term,
         `Estimate`=Estimate,
         `SE`=`Std. Error`,
         `z-value`=`z value`,
         `p-value`=`Pr(>|z|)`)%>%
  mutate(`p-value`=ifelse(`p-value`<0.001,"<0.001",sprintf("%.3f",`p-value`)))

larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion_value <-trunc(unname(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion$statistic)*1000)/1000

larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table_word<-flextable(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  colformat_double(j=c("Estimate","SE","z-value"),digits=3)%>%
  add_footer_lines(values=paste0("DHARMa dispersion parameter= ",larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion_value,
                                 ", p = ",larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_dispersion$p.value))%>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman",part="all")%>%
  fontsize(size=12,part="all")%>%
  set_caption("Table S2. glmmTMB Beta-binomial model coefficients for larval survivorship.")%>%
  bold(part="header")%>%
  align(align="center",part="all")%>%
  align(j="Term",align="left",part="all")%>%
  autofit()

larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table_word

save_as_docx(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table_word,
             path="output/larval_survivorship_glmmtmb_table.docx")

larval_survivorship_anova<-car::Anova(larval_survivorship_glmmtmb)%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("effect")%>%
  mutate(`Pr(>Chisq)`=case_when(`Pr(>Chisq)`<0.001~"<0.001",TRUE~sprintf("%.3f",`Pr(>Chisq)`)))%>%
  select(effect,Chisq,Df,`Pr(>Chisq)`)%>%
  rename(`Effect`=effect,
         `χ²`=Chisq,
         `df`=Df,
         `p-value`=`Pr(>Chisq)`)

larval_survivorship_anova_word<-flextable(larval_survivorship_anova)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  colformat_double(j="χ²",digits=3)%>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman",part="all")%>%
  fontsize(size=12,part="all")%>%
  set_caption("Table S3. Beta-binomial model results for larval survivorship.")%>%
  bold(part="header")%>%
  align(align="center",part="all")%>%
  align(j="Effect",align="left",part="all")%>%
  autofit()

larval_survivorship_anova_word

save_as_docx(larval_survivorship_anova_word,
             path="output/larval_survivorship_anova_table.docx")

larval_survivorship_contrast_table<-larval_survivorship_time_contrast_holm%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  select(treatment,contrast,odds.ratio,SE,z.ratio,p.value)%>%
  mutate(p.value=case_when(p.value<0.001~"<0.001", TRUE~sprintf("%.3f",p.value)))%>%
  rename(`Treatment (°C)`=treatment,
         `Comparison`=contrast,
         `Odds Ratio`=odds.ratio,
         `SE`=SE,
         `z-ratio`=z.ratio,
         `p-value`=p.value)

larval_survivorship_contrast_table_word<-flextable(larval_survivorship_contrast_table)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  colformat_double(j=c("Odds Ratio","SE","z-ratio"),digits=3)%>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman",part="all")%>%
  fontsize(size=12,part="all")%>%
  set_caption("Table S4. Post-hoc comparisons of larval survivorship between observation times within each temperature treatment. Holm-adjusted across the 12 comparisons.")%>%
  bold(part="header")%>%
  align(align="center",part="all")%>%
  autofit()

larval_survivorship_contrast_table_word

save_as_docx(larval_survivorship_contrast_table_word,
             path="output/larval_survivorship_contrast_table.docx")

larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table<-larval_survivorship_trt_ctrl_contrast%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  select(time,contrast,odds.ratio,SE,z.ratio,p.value)%>%
  mutate(p.value=case_when(p.value<0.001~"<0.001", TRUE~sprintf("%.3f",p.value)))%>%
  rename(`Time (h)`=time,
         `Comparison`=contrast,
         `Odds Ratio`=odds.ratio,
         `SE`=SE,
         `z-ratio`=z.ratio,
         `p-value`=p.value)

larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table_word<-flextable(larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  colformat_double(j=c("Odds Ratio","SE","z-ratio"),digits=3)%>%

  fontsize(size=12,part="all")%>%

  bold(part="header")%>%
  align(align="center",part="all")%>%
  autofit()

larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table_word

save_as_docx(larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table_word,
             path="output/larval_survivorship_contrast_trt_ctrl_table.docx")
```

# Initial Settlement

## Data

```{r}
initial_settlement <- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/settlement_counts.xlsx", sheet = i))%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  rename(treatment=temp)%>%
  group_by(treatment)%>%
  mutate(average= mean(spat, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  filter(plug!=156)%>%
  mutate(chamber = interaction(treatment, replicate, drop = TRUE))

summary(initial_settlement)

table(initial_settlement$treatment,initial_settlement$replicate)

levels(as.factor(initial_settlement$treatment))

str(initial_settlement)
```

## Statistical Analysis

```{r}
initial_settlement_model<-MASS::glm.nb(spat~as.factor(treatment),data=initial_settlement)
summary(initial_settlement_model)

initial_settlement_model$theta #dispersion
nb_res <- simulateResiduals(initial_settlement_model)
testZeroInflation(nb_res)

car::Anova(initial_settlement_model)

emm_treatment_ambient <- emmeans(initial_settlement_model, ~ treatment, type= "response")
emm_treatment_ambient

initial_settlement_contrast <- contrast(emm_treatment_ambient,"trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1)
initial_settlement_contrast

```

## Plot

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3.5}
x_positions_1 <- c(32)
x_positions_2 <- c(33,35,36)
x_positions_3 <- c(34,38)

initial_settlement_plot <- ggplot(initial_settlement)+
  geom_jitter(aes(treatment, spat, color=as.factor(treatment)),height = 0, width = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(treatment,average))+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1.041667), linetype="dashed",size=0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(treatment, average, color=as.factor(treatment)),size=4,pch=21,fill="white", stroke=1)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(27,38,1))+
  xlab("Temperature (°C)")+
  ylab("Settled Juveniles (1 Week)")+
  scale_color_discrete("Treatment (°C)")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  annotate("text",27,15,label="Treatment p<0.001",hjust=0, size=2.98)+
  map(x_positions_1, ~annotate("text", .x, -1, label="***", size=5))+
  map(x_positions_2, ~annotate("text", .x, -1, label="**", size=5))+
  map(x_positions_3, ~annotate("text", .x, -1, label="*", size=5))

initial_settlement_plot

ggsave("output/initial_settlement_plot.pdf",
       plot=initial_settlement_plot,
       width=5.5,height=3.5,units="in")

```

## Tables

```{r}
initial_settlement_glm_table<-as.data.frame(summary(initial_settlement_model)$coefficients)%>%
  rownames_to_column("term")%>%
  rename(`Term`=term,
         `Estimate`=Estimate,
         `SE`=`Std. Error`,
         `z-value`=`z value`,
         `p-value`=`Pr(>|z|)`)%>%
  mutate(`p-value`=case_when(`p-value`<0.001~"<0.001",TRUE~sprintf("%.3f",trunc(`p-value`*1000)/1000)))

initial_settlement_glm_table_word<-flextable(initial_settlement_glm_table)%>%
  theme_booktabs()%>%
  colformat_double(j=c("Estimate","SE","z-value"),digits=3)%>%
  add_footer_lines(values=paste0("Negative-binomial dispersion parameter = ",trunc(initial_settlement_model$theta*1000)/1000))%>%
```

# Post-Settlement Survivorship

## Data

```{r}
week_1_survivorship<- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/week_1_survival_counts.xlsx", sheet = i)) %>% bind_rows() %>% clean_names()

week_2_survivorship<- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/week_2_survival_counts.xlsx", sheet = i))%>% bind_rows()%>% clean_names()

week_3_survivorship<- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/week_3_survival_counts.xlsx", sheet = i))%>% bind_rows()%>% clean_names()

week_5_survivorship<- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/week_5_survival_counts.xlsx", sheet = i))%>% bind_rows()%>% clean_names()

week_24_survivorship<- lapply(1:12, function(i) read_excel("data/week_24_survival_counts.xlsx", sheet = i))%>% bind_rows()%>% clean_names()

post_settlement_survivorship<-bind_rows(week_1_survivorship,week_2_survivorship,week_3_survivorship,week_5_survivorship,week_24_survivorship)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(plug)%>%
  filter(any(week==1 & individual>0))%>%
  arrange(plug,week)%>%
  mutate(initial=individual[week==1][1])%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(plug,temp,week,individual,initial)%>%
  rename(treatment=temp)%>%
  rename(alive=individual)%>%
  mutate(dead=initial-alive)%>%
  #filter(week!=1)%>%
  mutate(treatment=as.factor(treatment))%>%
  mutate(week=as.numeric(as.character(week)))%>%
  droplevels()

summary(post_settlement_survivorship)

post_settlement_survivorship%>%
  filter(dead<0)

post_settlement_survivorship_observed<-post_settlement_survivorship%>%
  group_by(treatment,week)%>%
  summarise(alive=sum(alive),
            initial=sum(initial),
            .groups="drop")%>%
  mutate(survivorship=alive/initial)

```

## Statistical Analysis

```{r}
post_settlement_survivorship_model<-glmmTMB(cbind(alive,dead)~treatment*week+(1|plug),family="binomial",data=post_settlement_survivorship)
summary(post_settlement_survivorship_model)

post_settlement_survivorship_res<-simulateResiduals(post_settlement_survivorship_model)
plot(post_settlement_survivorship_res)
post_settlement_survivorship_dispersion<-testDispersion(post_settlement_survivorship_res)

post_settlement_survivorship_anova<- car::Anova(post_settlement_survivorship_model)
post_settlement_survivorship_anova

emm_post_settlement_survivorship_trend<-emtrends(post_settlement_survivorship_model,~treatment, var= "week", type="response")
summary(emm_post_settlement_survivorship_trend) 

post_settlement_survivorship_trt_ctrl_contrast <- contrast(emm_post_settlement_survivorship_trend,"trt.vs.ctrl",ref=1)
post_settlement_survivorship_trt_ctrl_contrast

#gets the predicted survivorship for each treatment at each week
#at=list(week=seq(2,24,0.1)) to created fitted smooth curves 
post_settlement_survivorship_pred_fitted_curve<-emmeans(post_settlement_survivorship_model,~treatment|week,at=list(week=seq(1,24,0.1)),type="response")%>%
  as.data.frame()

```

## Plot

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3.5}

post_settlement_survivorship_pred_fitted_curve_all<-post_settlement_survivorship_pred_fitted_curve%>%
  select(treatment,week,prob)%>%
  arrange(treatment,week)

post_settlement_survivorship_plot<-ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=post_settlement_survivorship_pred_fitted_curve_all,
            aes(week,prob,color=treatment,group=treatment))+
  geom_point(data=post_settlement_survivorship_observed,
             aes(week,survivorship,color=treatment),size=2)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,2,3,5,24))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.2),limits=c(0,1))+
  xlab("Weeks Post-settlement")+
  ylab("Survivorship probability")+
  scale_color_discrete("Treatment (°C)")+
  annotate("text",1,0.4,label="Treatment p=0.097\nWeek p<0.001\nTreatment*Week p=0.009",hjust=0, size=2.98)+ #3,0.2
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)+
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE,title.position="top",override.aes=list(shape=16,linetype=1,size=0.7)))+
  theme(legend.position=c(0.31,0.12),
        legend.direction="horizontal",
        legend.title=element_text(hjust=0),
        legend.background=element_blank())

post_settlement_survivorship_plot

ggsave("output/post_settlement_survivorship_plot.pdf",
       plot=post_settlement_survivorship_plot,
       width=5.5,height=3.5,units="in")

```
